label: AI tools, news & discussion
evidence_summary: ChatGPT, tools, models and thread-summary keywords; samples span coding, subscriptions, applications and debate. A broad discussion group, not a uniform stance.

label: AI-art debate & criticism
evidence_summary: Art, artists and generated-image keywords; sampled posts include artistic objections, deepfake concerns and wider AI debate. Not every author opposes AI, and some posts are unrelated word or game references.

label: AI debate, politics & trading
evidence_summary: Keyword totals emphasise price/profit, but the distinct-author sample includes political-bias criticism, general AI discussion and mixed content. Trading is not treated as the identity of all members.

label: AI in education & research
evidence_summary: Education, research, writing and student keywords; samples include teaching, research tools, ethics and academic events, with some general commentary.

label: AI-art sharing & NFTs
evidence_summary: AI-art, Midjourney, collection and NFT keywords; samples prominently share generated artwork, art sales and image tools. Some criticism occurs; the label does not mean every member endorses AI art.

label: AI technology & industry news
evidence_summary: Machine-learning, data-science and automated-feed keywords; the cross-author sample is broader technology, industry and application news. Automated photo-feed terms do not establish that the community consists of bots.

label: AI crypto projects & launchpads
evidence_summary: Launchpad, AIPAD, crypto and token keywords; samples broadly promote or discuss AI-related crypto projects, NFTs and launches. No inference of coordination or account automation.

label: AI & blockchain projects
evidence_summary: Blockchain, Matrix, tokens and project keywords; samples combine AI-linked crypto investment, blockchain applications and general AI content.

label: AI research & healthcare
evidence_summary: Preprint and generated-haiku terms appear in aggregate keywords; distinct-author samples prominently include medical AI, research, technical tools and policy. The name follows that broader evidence rather than calling all members haiku accounts.

label: NFT collections & AI art
evidence_summary: NFT, llama and art-collection terms; samples include collection promotion, AI artwork and trading-related discussion. Llama collection mentions are not necessarily language-model references.

label: AI-token trading & promotion
evidence_summary: AI-token, Telegram and crypto-project terms; samples discuss token launches, trading, project promotion and AI-branded products. Promotional content does not prove coordinated or automated activity.

label: Portrait apps & general chat
evidence_summary: Dawn and portrait-app keywords; samples mix avatar generation with informal multilingual conversation and unrelated uses of ai. No location or ethnicity is inferred.

label: Anime-style AI images
evidence_summary: Stable Diffusion, NovelAI, anime and image tags; samples include generated anime-style images, commissions, adult-oriented content and art debate. Content description only.

label: AI-art debate & image prompts
evidence_summary: Art, image-prompt and debate keywords; samples combine support, objections and general discussion of generated images and creative tools. A mixed stance, not an exclusively pro- or anti-AI group.

label: AI, writing & creative media
evidence_summary: Generated-image and feed keywords; sampled posts additionally cover fiction, music, writing and general AI commentary. Broad creative-media label retained at low confidence.

label: AI stocks & trading posts
evidence_summary: Stock, trading and AI-company keywords; samples contain substantial stock-ticker discussion alongside technology news and general AI commentary.

label: ChatGPT tools & general chat
evidence_summary: ChatGPT and tool keywords; samples mix coding, education, general conversation, politics and wordplay. No geographic or demographic identity is assigned.

label: Web3, music & marketing
evidence_summary: Web3, music and marketing keywords; the cross-author sample is diffuse, including creative tools, commentary, crypto and unrelated references. This is a loose descriptive grouping.

label: AI content & marketing
evidence_summary: Content, SEO, marketing and writing-tool keywords; samples support a focus on content production and marketing applications, alongside broader technical commentary.

label: AI industry & India news
evidence_summary: Industry, technology and India-reference keywords; samples include AI products, policy and news. At least one sampled ai reference is Air India, and no author location is inferred.

label: Games & game-development AI
evidence_summary: Game-development terms and promotional keywords; the distinct-author sample mainly concerns game AI, indie development, tools and games. Business-promotion keywords do not justify defining the whole group as promotion.
